subject: Re: Lakeside walk plan
text:
Hey,

Following up on our chat about the weekend lakeside walk - good news, the path is open and the forecast is looking pretty kind. Still, there is a small curveball. The group rental van we counted on picked up a late fee, so the cost per car jumped by about eight dollars. Nobody needs to feel embarrassed saying yes or no; it is totally fine to skip the van and meet us there.

If the change still feels okay, I'd say we go in twelve each instead of six. That covers the van and leaves a little cushion for ice cream, which I fully expect to happen. We could keep the potluck as a bring-your-own thing - maybe someone can grab fruit, someone else lemonade, and I will handle napkins again. Also, when your parents and I caught up, they said they can split a dessert.

Could you let me know by Wednesday? I'm trying to lock the van down before the evening rush. If the extra few dollars are annoying, speak up now; better awkward now than last-minute. Please wear shoes that can handle gravel; last time people underestimated the shoreline. Either way, it should be a blast.

Catch soon,
